page.overview:
What is Casseroya Lake?

Casseroya Lake is a location introduced in .

Casseroya Lake is a large lake within the North Province of Paldea. It is located north of Areas Two and Three of the North Province, as well as being west of Glaseado Mountain. Socarrat Trail is located within Casseroya Lake. A few Legendary Pokémon appear in Casseroya Lake, including Kyogre, Suicune, and Lunala.
